Buying guide and item details

Verify the credited UC amount and the full price

The quantity named in an offer is the first detail to check. Distinguish base UC, bonus UC and event-specific rewards because they can have separate eligibility rules. Some promotions vary by region or limited-time event. Read the actual product description and ask for the complete USD charge including any relevant fees. A price comparison is misleading if it mixes different currency amounts or conditional bonuses.

An offer with a dramatic discount is not automatically legitimate. Compare the stated amount with current authorized purchase channels and avoid irreversible payments to unidentified accounts.

Use your player identity carefully

A legitimate in-game credit flow may require a PUBG Mobile Player ID, but it should not require the buyer to disclose their password, email login, two-factor code or full account-recovery information. Double-check the exact player identifier in the game before sharing it through a supported process. If a seller requests sensitive credentials, do not proceed.

Keep copies of your own transaction records and any published refund conditions, with private information redacted if asking for support. Never publish the full payment or identification details in a public review.

International availability is not automatic

Storefronts may impose region-specific currency, account or payment restrictions. A USD price is a reference, not a promise that every country can place the same order. Confirm whether the recipient account is eligible for the selected credit method and whether the exact amount can be delivered. PUBG Mobile's rules restrict unauthorized virtual currency transactions, so the publisher's current guidance must take precedence.

A claimed instant delivery time is not a guarantee unless the provider can actually fulfill the order. If the product description does not specify verification steps or timing, ask for clarification before sending money.
